# Software bill of materials (SBOM)

Components Swift NAVFIT 0.56.0-dev uses at run time, from a fresh build and the VBA source. The same inventory is in CycloneDX 1.5 form in [sbom.cdx.json](sbom.cdx.json). Swift ships no third-party code libraries: everything it calls at run time is part of Windows or Microsoft Office. Swift NAVFIT itself is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 ([LICENSE](../../LICENSE)).

## Platform

| Component | Supplier | Requirement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Microsoft Access (desktop), VBA 7, ACE database engine | Microsoft | Desktop Access 2016 or later, including Microsoft 365. Access Runtime is not supported. |
